changes.title: Record verified TEST232 evidence
changes.text: Retain the exact TEST232 core, Android, visual, APK and targeted-reproduction evidence without rebuilding or publishing unchanged application source.

changes.title: Exclude long idle gaps from active-play time
changes.text: Active-time telemetry no longer credits 30 seconds after an app-background or long-pause gap; normal short gaps and all gameplay remain unchanged.

commentary: TEST232 is the immediate previous produced APK and TEST231 remains the latest privately delivered fallback. The active-time correction requires exact before/after core evidence and one complete TEST233 application gate; no automatic delivery.
